name: org_teach
description: C7b (brief 47 scenario 6 at island scale): two factions of six founding adults; one adult per faction (the highest id) can teach gathering wood with an axe (Orgs.C7.StartTeachers = 1, skill 600). Nothing scripted: it offers lessons by gesture to household members and people it trusts, demonstrates to others in sight; learners choose to attend; copied associations (Origin.Imitated / Vicarious) and skill gains are measured on the learners. Civ is on only for the shared skill store (R42; C1 building and C3 hiring off). Control: org_teach_none. 15 sim days.
